name: Order or the Iron Fist Cavalier/Samurai Order
body:
A cavalier who belongs to this order has pledged themselves to rulership by crushing down the weak and taking from their hopes of freedom. Cavaliers of this order instill doubt and sow hopelessness to gain more power for themselves, their order and their leader.

Edicts: The cavalier must instill doubt and hopelessness in the weak and they must enforce their orders by force if necessary. However, hopelessness brought about by their iron rule should be sufficient.

Since these edicts are about control by evil means, they must be of a lawful evil alignment.

Challenge: Whenever an order of the iron fist cavalier issues a challenge, the target of the challenge takes a -1 penalty on attack rolls and saves vs. fear and despair for one round after being damaged by the cavalier. The penalties do not stack for multiple hits in one round.

This penalty increases by 1 for every 4 levels the cavalier has (to a maximum of -5 at 16th level).

Skills: An order of the iron fist cavalier adds Knowledge (local) and Knowledge (nobility) to their list of class skills. Whenever an the cavalier uses Intimidate to induce despair (See New Skill Uses on page 43 of this book), they receive a bonus on that check equal to 1/2 their cavalier level (minimum +1).

Order Abilities

A cavalier who belongs to the order of the iron fist gains the following abilities as they increase in level.

Sowing Discord (Ex)

At 2nd level, whenever the order of the iron fist cavalier uses Intimidate to induce despair (See New Skill Uses on page 43 of this book) in one or more creatures, they can attempt to induce despair to an equal number of allies within 30 feet as a free action. While within 30 feet of an ally with the doubting, despairing or hopeless condition, the cavalier gains a +1 morale bonus on saving throws.

At 6th level and every 6 levels thereafter, this bonus increases by 1. The cavalier can perform a trip or bull rush combat maneuver against creatures with the doubting, despairing or hopeless condition without provoking an attack of opportunity.

Drive the Weak (Ex)

At 8th level, the cavalier treats all of their allies with the doubting, despairing or hopeless conditions as though they had the same teamwork feats as the cavalier for the purpose of determining whether the cavalier receives a bonus from their teamwork feats. Their allies do not receive any bonuses or benefits from these feats unless they have the feats themselves as well.

The allies’ positioning and actions must still meet the prerequisites listed in the teamwork feat for the cavalier to receive the listed bonus. When the cavalier uses tactician, greater tactician, or mighty tactician, the duration doubles for any creatures that have no more than half the cavalier’s Hit Dice or that have the doubting, despairing or hopeless conditions when they activate this ability.

Sapping of Hopes (Ex)

At 15th level, the cavalier can destroy the hopes of their enemies. The target of their challenge cannot benefit from any morale bonuses while the challenge is active. On each successful hit against the challenge target, all enemies within 30 feet that can see the combat must make a Will save equal to 10 + 1/2 their cavalier level + their Charisma modifier or be subject to the doubting condition. This is a mind-affecting despair effect.
